verses.geez: ወወድቀ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገጸ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወበከየ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept on him, and kissed him.

translations.lxx: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept on him, and kissed him.
translations.kjv: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
translations.ron: Atunci Iosif, căzând pe faţa tatălui său, l-a plâns şi l-a sărutat.

verses.geez:
ወአዘዞሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለአግብርቲሁ ፡ እለ ፡ ይቀርቡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይቀብሩ ፡ ይቅብርዎ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወቀበርዎ ፡
                  ለእስራኤል ፡ እለ ፡ ይቀብሩ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph commanded his servants the embalmers to embalm his father; and the embalmers embalmed Israel.

translations.lxx: And Joseph commanded his servants the embalmers to embalm his father; and the embalmers embalmed Israel.
translations.kjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
translations.ron: Apoi a poruncit Iosif doctorilor, slujitori ai săi, să îmbălsămeze pe tatăl său şi doctorii au îmbălsămat pe Israel.

verses.geez:
ወፈጸሙ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ አርብዓ ፡ ጽባሐ ፡ እስመ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይኌልቁ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ በዘ ፡ ቀበሩ ፤ ወላሐዉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ግብጽ
                  ፡ ሰብዓ ፡ መዋዕለ ።
verses.translation: And they fulfilled forty days for him, for so are the days of embalming numbered; and Egypt mourned for him seventy days.

translations.lxx: And they fulfilled forty days for him, for so are the days of embalming numbered; and Egypt mourned for him seventy days.
translations.kjv: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
translations.ron: După ce s-au împlinit patruzeci de zile, că atâtea zile trebuie pentru îmbălsămare, l-au plâns Egiptenii şaptezeci de zile.

verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ ተፈጸመ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ላሕ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለኀያላነ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ እመ ፡ ረከብኩ ፡
                  ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜክሙ ፡ ንግርዎ ፡ በእንቲአየ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወበልዎ ፤
verses.translation: And when the days of mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the princes of Pharao, saying, If I have found favour in your sight, speak concerning me in the ears of Pharao, saying,

translations.lxx: And when the days of mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the princes of Pharao, saying, If I have found favour in your sight, speak concerning me in the ears of Pharao, saying,
translations.kjv: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
translations.ron: Iar dacă au trecut zilele plângerii lui, a zis Iosif curtenilor lui Faraon: "De am aflat bunăvoinţă în ochii voştri, ziceţi lui Faraon aşa:

verses.geez:
አቡየአ ፡ አምሐለኒ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ይሙት ፡ ወይቤለኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃብር ፡ ዘከረይኩ ፡ ሊተ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ህየ
                  ፡ ቅብረኒ ፡ ወይእዜኒ ፡ እዕረግ ፡ ወእቅብሮ ፡ ለአቡየ ፡ ወእግባእ ።
verses.translation: My father adjured me, saying, In the sepulchre which I dug for myself in the land of Chanaan, there thou shalt bury me; now then I will go up and bury my father, and return again.

translations.lxx: My father adjured me, saying, In the sepulchre which I dug for myself in the land of Chanaan, there thou shalt bury me; now then I will go up and bury my father, and return again.
translations.kjv: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
translations.ron: Tatăl meu m-a jurat şi a zis: Iată, eu am să mor; tu însă să mă îngropi în mormântul meu, pe care mi l-am săpat eu în pământul Canaan. Şi acum aş vrea să mă duc ca să îngrop pe tatăl meu şi să mă întorc". şi i s-au spus lui Faraon cuvintele lui Iosif,

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ዕረግ ፡ ወቅብሮ ፡ ለአቡከ ፡ በከመ ፡ አምሐለከ ።
verses.translation: And Pharao said to Joseph, Go up, bury thy father, as he constrained thee to swear.

translations.lxx: And Pharao said to Joseph, Go up, bury thy father, as he constrained thee to swear.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
translations.ron: Iar Faraon a răspuns: "Du-te şi îngroapă pe tatăl tău, cum te-a jurat el!"

verses.geez:
ወዐርገ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ይቅብሮ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወዐርጉ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወዐርጉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡
                  ግብጽ ፤
verses.translation: So Joseph went up to bury his father; and all the servants of Pharao went up with him, and the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt.

translations.lxx: So Joseph went up to bury his father; and all the servants of Pharao went up with him, and the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
translations.ron: Deci, s-a dus Iosif să îngroape pe tatăl său şi au mers împreună cu el toţi slujitorii lui Faraon, bătrânii casei lui şi toţi bătrânii din ţara Egiptului

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ወአኀዊሁ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወአዝማዲሁ ፤ ወአባግዒሆሙሰ ፡
                  ወአልህምቲሆሙ ፡ ኀደጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ጌሴም ።
verses.translation: And all the household of Joseph, and his brethren, and all the house of his father, and his kindred; and they left behind the sheep and the oxen in the land of Gesem.

translations.lxx: And all the household of Joseph, and his brethren, and all the house of his father, and his kindred; and they left behind the sheep and the oxen in the land of Gesem.
translations.kjv: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
translations.ron: Şi toată casa lui Iosif şi fraţii lui şi toată casa tatălui său şi neamul lui. Numai copiii lor şi oile şi vitele lor le-au lăsat în ţara Goşen.

verses.geez: ወዐርገ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ሰረገላት ፡ ወአፍራስ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ትዕይንቶሙ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.translation: And there went up with him also chariots and horsemen; and there was a very great company.

translations.lxx: And there went up with him also chariots and horsemen; and there was a very great company.
translations.kjv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
translations.ron: Au plecat de asemenea cu el căruţe şi călăreţi şi s-a făcut tabăra mare foarte.

verses.geez:
ወበጽሑ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ እክል ፡ ዘአጣታ ፡ ዘሀሎ ፡ ማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወበከይዎ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ብካየ ፡ ወጽኑዐ ፡
                  ጥቀ ፡ ላሐ ፡ ገብሩ ፡ ለአቡሆሙ ፡ ሰ[ቡ]ዐ ፡ መዋዕለ ።
verses.translation: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan; and they bewailed him with a great and very sore lamentation; and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

translations.lxx: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan; and they bewailed him with a great and very sore lamentation; and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
translations.kjv: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
translations.ron: Şi ajungând ei la aria lui Atad de lângă Iordan, au plâns acolo plângere mare şi tare foarte şi a jelit Iosif pe tatăl său şapte zile.

verses.geez:
ወርእዩ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ውእተ ፡ ላሐ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ እክል ፡ ዘአጣታ ፡ ወይቤሉ
                  ፡ ከመዝኑ ፡ ላሕ ፡ ዘግብጽ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ሰመይዎ ፡ ስሞ ፡ ላሐ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ዘበማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ።
verses.translation: And the inhabitants of the land of Chanaan saw the mourning at the floor of Atad, and said, This is a great mourning to the Egyptians; therefore he called its name, The mourning of Egypt, which is beyond Jordan.

translations.lxx: And the inhabitants of the land of Chanaan saw the mourning at the floor of Atad, and said, This is a great mourning to the Egyptians; therefore he called its name, The mourning of Egypt, which is beyond Jordan.
translations.kjv: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
translations.ron: Văzând Canaaneii, locuitorii ţinutului aceluia, plângerea de la aria Atad, au zis: "Mare e plângerea aceasta la Egipteni". De aceea s-a dat locului aceluia numele Abel-Miţraim, adică plângerea Egiptenilor, care loc e dincolo de Iordan.

verses.geez: ወከመዝ ፡ ገብሩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ወቀበርዎ ፡ ህየ ።
verses.translation: And thus his sons did to him.

translations.lxx: And thus his sons did to him.
translations.kjv: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
translations.ron: Aşa au făcut fiii lui Iacov cu Iacov, cum le poruncise el:

verses.geez:
ወእግብእዎ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወቀበርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በዐት ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሣየጠ ፡ [አብርሃም ፡]
                  ለመቃብር ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኤፌሮን ፡ ኬጥያዊ ፡ እንተ ፡ አንጻረ ፡ ምንባሬ ።
verses.translation: So his sons carried him up into the land of Chanaan, and buried him in the double cave, which cave Abraam bought for possession of a burying place, of Ephrom the Chettite, before Mambre.

translations.lxx: So his sons carried him up into the land of Chanaan, and buried him in the double cave, which cave Abraam bought for possession of a burying place, of Ephrom the Chettite, before Mambre.
translations.kjv: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
translations.ron: L-au dus fiii lui în pământul Canaan şi l-au îngropat în peştera din ţarina Macpela, cea de lângă Mamvri, pe care o cumpărase Avraam cu ţarină cu tot de la Efron Heteul, ca moşie de îngropare.

verses.geez:
ወገብአ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ እለ ፡ ዐርጉ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ይቅብርዎ ፡
                  ለአቡሆሙ ፡ ወአኀዊሁኒ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brethren, and those that had gone up with him to bury his father.

translations.lxx: And Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brethren, and those that had gone up with him to bury his father.
translations.kjv: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
translations.ron: Apoi Iosif, după îngroparea tatălui său, s-a întors în Egipt, şi el, şi fraţii lui, şi toţi cei ce merseseră cu el la îngroparea tatălui său.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ አኀዊሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሞተ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ ዮጊ ፡ ይዜከር ፡ ለነ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ እኪተ ፡
                  እንተ ፡ ገበርነ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወያገብእ ፡ ለነ ፡ ፍዳሃ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ እኪት ፡ እንተ ፡ አርአይናሁ ።
verses.translation: And when the brethren of Joseph saw that their father was dead, they said, Let us take heed, lest at any time Joseph remember evil against us, and recompense to us all the evils which we have done against him.

translations.lxx: And when the brethren of Joseph saw that their father was dead, they said, Let us take heed, lest at any time Joseph remember evil against us, and recompense to us all the evils which we have done against him.
translations.kjv: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
translations.ron: Văzând însă fraţii lui Iosif că a murit tatăl lor, au zis ei: "Ce vom face, dacă Iosif ne va urî şi va vrea să se răzbune pentru răul ce i-am făcut?

verses.geez: ወመጽኡ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ አኀዊሁ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ አቡከ ፡ አምሕሎ ፡ አምሐለነ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ይሙት ፤
verses.translation: And they came to Joseph, and said, Thy father adjured us before his death, saying,

translations.lxx: And they came to Joseph, and said, Thy father adjured us before his death, saying,
translations.kjv: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
translations.ron: Atunci au trimis ei la Iosif să i se spună: "Tatăl tău înainte de moarte te-a jurat şi a zis:

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ በልዎ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ ኅድግአ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ አበሳሆሙ ፡ ወጌጋዮሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ እኪተአ ፡ አርአዩከ ፡
                  ወይእዜኒአ ፡ ስረይ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ ፡ ለአግብርቲከ ፡ በአምላኮሙ ፡ ለአበዊከአ ፤ ወበከየ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይትናገርዎ
                  ።
verses.translation: Thus say ye to Joseph, Forgive them their injustice and their sin, forasmuch as they have done thee evil; and now pardon the injustice of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept while they spoke to him.

translations.lxx: Thus say ye to Joseph, Forgive them their injustice and their sin, forasmuch as they have done thee evil; and now pardon the injustice of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept while they spoke to him.
translations.kjv: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
translations.ron: "Aşa să spuneţi lui Iosif: Iartă fraţilor tăi greşeala şi păcatul lor şi răul ce ţi-au făcut. Iartă deci vina robilor Dumnezeului tatălui tău!" Şi a plâns Iosif când i s-au spus acestea.

verses.geez: ወመጽኡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ለከ ፡ አግብርተ ።
verses.translation: And they came to him and said, We, these persons, are thy servants.

translations.lxx: And they came to him and said, We, these persons, are thy servants.
translations.kjv: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
translations.ron: Apoi au venit şi fraţii lui şi, căzând înaintea lui, au zis: "Iată, noi suntem robii tăi".

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ኢተፍርሁ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ አነ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph said to them, Fear not, for I am God's.

translations.lxx: And Joseph said to them, Fear not, for I am God's.
translations.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
translations.ron: Iar Iosif le-a zis: "Nu vă temeţi! Sunt eu, oare, în locul lui Dumnezeu?

verses.geez:
አንትሙሰ ፡ መከርክሙ ፡ እኪተ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ መከረ ፡ ሠናይተ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ዮም
                  ፡ በዘ ፡ ይሴሰይ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ብዙኅ ።
verses.translation: Ye took counsel against me for evil, but God took counsel for me for good, that the matter might be as it is to-day, and much people might be fed.

translations.lxx: Ye took counsel against me for evil, but God took counsel for me for good, that the matter might be as it is to-day, and much people might be fed.
translations.kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
translations.ron: Iată, voi aţi uneltit asupra mea rele, dar Dumnezeu le-a întors în bine, ca să facă cele ce sunt acum şi să păstreze viaţa unui popor numeros.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ኢትፍርሁ ፡ አነ ፡ እሴስየክሙ ፡ ለቤትክሙሂ ፡ ወጸውዖሙ ፡ ወተናገሮሙ ፡ ዘይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ።
verses.translation: And he said to them, Fear not, I will maintain you, and your families: and he comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

translations.lxx: And he said to them, Fear not, I will maintain you, and your families: and he comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
translations.kjv: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
translations.ron: Deci nu vă mai temeţi! Eu vă voi hrăni pe voi şi pe copiii voştri". Şi i-a mângâiat şi le-a vorbit de la inimă.

verses.geez:
ወነበረ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወአኀዊሁ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወሐይወ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ምእተ ፡
                  ወዐሠርተ ፡ ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his brethren, and all the family of his father; and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.

translations.lxx: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his brethren, and all the family of his father; and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.
translations.kjv: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
translations.ron: Apoi a locuit Iosif în Egipt, el şi fraţii lui şi toată casa tatălui său. Şi a trăit Iosif o sută zece ani.

verses.geez:
ወርእየ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ እስከ ፡ ሣልስ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ማኪር ፡ ወልደ ፡ ምናሴ ፡ እለ ፡ ተወልዱ
                  ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሕፅኑ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph saw the children of Ephraim to the third generation; and the sons of Machir the son of Manasse were borne on the sides of Joseph.

translations.lxx: And Joseph saw the children of Ephraim to the third generation; and the sons of Machir the son of Manasse were borne on the sides of Joseph.
translations.kjv: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.
translations.ron: Şi a văzut Iosif pe urmaşii lui Efraim până la al treilea neam. De asemenea şi copiii lui Machir, fiul lui Manase, s-au născut pe genunchii lui Iosif.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለአኅዊሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ አንሰ ፡ እመውት ፡ ወአመ ፡ ሐወጸክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአውፅአክሙ
                  ፡ እምዛቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአበዊነ ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ወለይስሐቅ ፡ ወለያዕቆብ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Joseph spoke to his brethren, saying, I die, and God will surely visit you, and will bring you out of this land to the land concerning which God sware to our fathers, Abraam, Isaac, and Jacob.

translations.lxx: And Joseph spoke to his brethren, saying, I die, and God will surely visit you, and will bring you out of this land to the land concerning which God sware to our fathers, Abraam, Isaac, and Jacob.
translations.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
translations.ron: În cele din urmă a zis Iosif către fraţii săi: "Iată, am să mor. Dar Dumnezeu vă va cerceta, vă va scoate din pământul acesta şi vă va duce în pământul pentru care Dumnezeul părinţilor noştri S-a jurat lui Avraam şi lui Isaac şi lui Iacov".

verses.geez:
ወአምሐሎሙ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ አመ ፡ ይሔውጸክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አውጽኡ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ፡
                  እምዝየ ፡ ምስሌክሙ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph adjured the sons of Israel, saying, At the visitation with which God shall visit you, then ye shall carry up my bones hence with you.

translations.lxx: And Joseph adjured the sons of Israel, saying, At the visitation with which God shall visit you, then ye shall carry up my bones hence with you.
translations.kjv: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
translations.ron: La urmă a jurat Iosif pe fiii lui Israel, zicând: "Dumnezeu are să vă cerceteze, dar voi să scoateţi oasele mele de aici!"

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ በምእት ፡ ወዐሠርቱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ወቀበርዎ ፡ ወሤምዎ ፡ በነፍቅ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph died, aged an hundred and ten years; and they prepared his corpse, and put him in a coffin in Egypt.

translations.lxx: And Joseph died, aged an hundred and ten years; and they prepared his corpse, and put him in a coffin in Egypt.
translations.kjv: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
translations.ron: Şi a murit Iosif de o sută zece ani. L-au îmbălsămat şi l-au pus într-un sicriu, în pământul Egiptului.
